name: signbridge-reception
description: A bounded, captions-first reception aid that retrieves Deaf-reviewed ASL phrase videos.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @signbridge/contracts build && pnpm --filter @signbridge/web build && pnpm --filter @signbridge/api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @signbridge/contracts build && pnpm --filter @signbridge/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @signbridge/api typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:line-endings && pnpm verify:no-secrets && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm catalog:verify && pnpm build
